capability_declaration.evidence: Clause 5 (General Requirements), particularly subclauses on DER response to abnormal voltage/frequency conditions, and Clause 10 (Interoperability) referencing IEEE 2030.5 (SEP2), which includes DER function set discovery mechanisms.
capability_declaration.rationale: IEEE 1547 defines mandatory functions (volt-var, frequency-watt) but largely defers dynamic capability declaration to companion standards like IEEE 2030.5. Partial, not explicit.

bounded_authority.evidence: Clause 5 defines voltage and frequency ride-through curves with mandatory trip limits. Clause 6.4.2 defines volt-var curve parameters with utility-configurable setpoints. Clause 8 (Power Quality) limits DER operation.
bounded_authority.rationale: Operational boundaries exist as technical constraints (curves, limits), but bounded authority as a formal concept—scope, expiry, revocation, override permissions—is only implicit from configurability.

decision_auditability.rationale: IEEE 1547 is a technical interconnection standard focused on performance and safety; it does not address logging, attribution, or traceability of agent decisions.

data_governance.rationale: The standard covers electrical performance and communication protocol references only. It does not address data ownership, consent, or retention requirements.
